en: A multi-view color postcard with four photographs of a small town and its surroundings. The top-left shows a stone monument in vineyards with the inscription "Weinort Pfaffenweiler" and a view of the town and church in the background. The top-right shows a traditional wooden wine press with flower decorations. The bottom-left depicts residential houses on a green hillside with gardens. The bottom-right shows a historic stepped-gable building on a square, next to a column with a statue, likely the town hall. In the middle, in red cursive script, is the caption "Gruß aus Pfaffenweiler".
